name: claude-code-katex
description: Adds LaTeX math rendering to Claude Code chat — inline $...$, display $$...$$, and \(...\) / \[...\]

claudeCodeKatex.macroFiles.markdownDescription:
LaTeX files whose macro definitions are made available to math in Claude Code chat — `\newcommand`, `\renewcommand`, `\providecommand`, `\def`, `\let` and `\DeclareMathOperator`. Anything else in the file (`\usepackage`, prose, comments) is ignored, and a definition KaTeX cannot handle is skipped without affecting the others.

Supports `~`, `${workspaceFolder}` and `${userHome}`; a relative path resolves against the first workspace folder.

Run **Claude Code LaTeX: Reload Macros** after editing one of these files.

claudeCodeKatex.macros.markdownDescription:
Macros in KaTeX's own form, for a handful of definitions without a file — for example `{ "\\RR": "\\mathbb{R}", "\\vv": "\\mathbf{#1}" }`.

Applied after `#claudeCodeKatex.macroFiles#`, so these win on a name defined by both.

claudeCodeKatex.renderPlanPreview.markdownDescription: Experimental: render LaTeX in Claude Code's plan approval view. This requires modifying Claude Code's host `extension.js`, with a validated backup and automatic restoration when disabled or uninstalled. Changing this setting prompts you to reload the VS Code window.
